# wg

> One local front door for semantic code search and ripgrep-compatible
> filesystem search, backed by one shared daemon.

## Install from source

cargo install --locked --path crates/wgrep-sgrep-core --bin wg

Requirements: Rust 1.90+, ripgrep (`rg`) on PATH, network on the first run
(about 33.5 MB for the code model, plus parser assets).

## Docs

- README: README.md
- Agent guide: docs/agent-guide.md
- Benchmarks: docs/benchmarks.md

## Commands

- wg up [PATH] [--model auto|code|text] [--json]
- wg QUERY [ROOT] [--top N|-k N] [--json] [--explain]
- wg [RIPGREP-FLAGS] PATTERN [PATH...]
- wg status [--json]
- wg down

## Contract

- Default route is sgrep-compatible semantic ranking. `--top N` / `-k N` sets
  the count (1..=100, default 5). `-n` means ripgrep line numbers.
- A ripgrep flag (`-F`, `-e`, `-n`, `-l`, `-g`, `--files`) selects exact
  filesystem search through an authoritative `rg` child in the same daemon.
- `--json` alone is semantic JSON. `--json` with ripgrep flags is ripgrep JSON.
- One daemon PID and one shared model pool serve every attached repository.
- Semantic scope is one whole attached repository. File or subdirectory semantic
  scope returns an explicit error.
- Exit codes: 0 matches, 1 no matches, 2 error.
